messages:
alex (Hiring Manager): Heads up — converting contractor Priya Shah to full-time. Manager wants start date backdated to 2026-03-01 so she doesn't lose probation-aligned bonus window. Is that allowed?

maria (Recruiter): Adding docs — offer ready, compensation band = IC4 (base 155k), sign-on = 10k. Manager asked for start date 2026-03-01 because contractor has been full-time equivalent since Feb.

nina (People Ops): Backdating is sensitive. We can do an employment start date earlier only in narrow cases (payroll/legal). Do you have manager justification and approval to grant benefits retro? We need headcount approval + finance OK.

alex (Hiring Manager): Yep — justification: seamless handoff, no gap in coverage, candidate already on contractor payroll since Feb. Manager approval attached in email (I can forward). Need to know if benefits (health enrollment) can be retro to 3/1.

jamal (Finance): FYI — retroactive benefits may change our monthly accruals. We'll need budget code and confirmation that comp band/bonus proration handled. Provide GL string and whether total comp exceeds level threshold.

maria (Recruiter): GL: ENG-PLATFORM-2026-01. Total comp w/ sign-on = 165k, within IC4 range. Will the sign-on be paid in one lump? Manager requested upfront.

nina (People Ops): Action items: 1) manager to confirm in-thread that they approve retro benefits and upfront sign-on (alex?). 2) finance (jamal) to confirm accrual impacts OK. 3) people ops to coordinate payroll cutoff with HRIS. If all good, we route to approvals committee for comp-band exception because of retro start date.

alex (Hiring Manager): I approve retro benefits and upfront sign-on. Confirmed. :white_check_mark:

jamal (Finance): We can absorb accrual with that GL, but if sign-on paid fully in this fiscal month, let me know by EOD. Approve from finance side pending payroll timing. :+1:

people-ops-bot: Reminder: retro start dates require a signed manager justification and VP approval when benefit enrollment is backdated. Please attach VP approval or route to approvals-committee@redwood.com.

nina (People Ops): Okay filing this as an exception. I'll open approvals ticket and ping VP ops. Maria — can you attach the offer PDF and manager email to the approvals ticket?

maria (Recruiter): Attached offer PDF to the ticket and CC'd alex's approval email. Ticket ID: PO-2026-459.

nina (People Ops): Great — once approvals committee signs off we'll confirm with payroll and set start date to 2026-03-01. Expect update within 48 hours. Anyone urgent needs, flag here. :eyes:
